title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Shifting of the Mosque 3964 views Q. about waqf property which is on rent 2140 views Q. In Shariah, Is it allowed to construct buildings in Muslim Cemeteries? In Sri Lanka, Cemeteries are belongs to Masjids. In recent years, Masjid Administration Boards have contructed shopping complexes to create income for Masjid's maintenance. This is really disturbing me much. If it is not allowed (haram) in Islam, can we pray in these kind of Masjids?, I expect a very very detail response from you. I am collecing opnions and articles from all the sources and going to fight against this issue in Sri Lanka. Please provide very detail reposne based on shariah. 1875 views Q. Assalam O Alaikum, This is regarding my previous question (Fatwa ID 13871). My earlier question was whether it is allowed or not to use illegal water and electricity in a Masjid. Illegal means theft of electricity and water. you answered that it is a sinful act. Now my further question is whether it is allowed for us (muqtadis) to offer the prayer in such place of worship where the water and electricity used is illegal. Please reply us soon. We muqtadis are unable to pay bills for water and electricity because here Mutawalli is a very corrupt man. He sells electricity to the tenants from the Masjid. And these tenants use heaters and other appliances very carelessly. 2237 views Q. We would like to ask a Shari Ruling regarding rent for a Madrasah which is based at an Islamic Secondary school building, the Islamic Secondary school building was opened by the current Chairman and the current Vice Chairman (a committee was later made on the bases that they would be supportive). Currently the Madrasah uses three classes in the evening for Madrasah. The Madrasah currently pay?s rent. But the issue has arisen about rent for the Madrasah when it first opened in 2004. Before the Madrasah opened, eminent scholars gave Mushwerah that the building was not used in the evenings and it would be suitable for evening Madrasah, through this it was then decided by the Chairman that the building can be used without any rent being paid, this was due to the Madrasah being new and to get the Madrasah running, at this time none of the Governors of the school were active in the daily issues of the school. From 2006 due to some issues (regarding the Islamic Secondary school) the Governors of the school got involved and they raised the issue of rent and they decided that rent should be back dated to (2004) and paid to the date of when payment first started (which was 2006). According to Shariah is it compulsory to for the Madrasah to pay the backdated rent? 1763 views Q. i ask you a question regarding shia land the question number and ur reply is mention here please reply as well as possible Allah Hafiz. Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakaatuhu ! We have received your question. Insha'Allah, it will be answered in the order in which it was received. Is the mimber (pulpit) is must in a mosque or not? 2196 views Q. Waqf land 3617 views Q. Waqf Alal awlad 2101 views Q. AA. about rebuild of very old and small masjid. for the many reason have to replaced and rebuilded a new big mosque nearby old mosque (approx 3 fit far).after demolish the old mosque land is empty now and next to busy road is it parmissible to do some shops on this empty land for the benefit of the mosque? massalam 1498 views Q. One arab muslim owns one mosque as his personal property. Imam is from Azhar and Azhar pays him salary. Problem is owner prays five times a day but his wife is an american christian. They married a long time ago but She did not accept islam and is continously in christian faith. Owner is getting old. If he dies the property goes to his wife. Suppose at that time if she allows muslims to pray in the mosque as usual. Then question is whether muslims are allowed to pray in the building owns by a christian or not. At this point owner refuses to transfer the building to the muslim community. Muslim community is very small and they do not have resources to buy an other building for mosque that cost lot of money. 1935 views Q. Information about Markaz 2670 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 44744 Country: AF Title: Waqf land Question: There is a Waqf Masjid and a man wants to change the land of that Waqf Masjid by another land, and that next land is beneficial for Masjid. Answer ID: 44744 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 680/400/L=1434) After the Waqf is solemnized and enforced then it is not lawful to change it with any other land. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
